question.text: If the DP sends certificates/documents to the incorrect R&T Agent, what happens?

answer.text: The wrong RTA will not retain any documents but will return all documents to the DP
The wrong RTA will process the request anyway
The documents are forwarded to the correct RTA

explanation.text: The Logic: If certificates are sent by the DP to the incorrect R&T Agent, the R&T Agent will not retain any incorrect or incomplete documents but will return all of them to the DP. The Trap: 'The wrong RTA will process anyway' is wrong — RTAs can only process securities for issuers they represent. Note: This is a procedural safeguard in the demat process described in the Series VI workbook.
